page_title: REN 2-0 ANG | Rennes v Angers 15/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.

90+2' 2 - 0 GOAL 2:0! Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) brilliantly slaloms his way forward past a few defenders and unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which is deflected and goes into the back of the net.
90+1' Flag goes up against Carlens Arcus (Angers) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
88' Jorge Sampaoli has decided to make a change. Carlos Andres Gomez (Rennes) replaces Arnaud Kalimuendo.
88' Substitution. Mahamadou Nagida makes his way off the pitch and Christopher Wooh (Rennes) comes on as his replacement.
87' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 3:0.
86' Jacques Ekomie (Angers) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
83' Carlens Arcus (Angers) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
82' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Angers.

82' From a seemingly non-threatining position, an indirect free kick is taken by Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) which creates a surprising opportunity, but the opposition's defence is alert and thwarts his attempt at last possible moment.
80' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem pulls out a yellow card.
78' Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) is booked.
77' Substitution. Ibrahima Niane walks off the pitch and Bamba Dieng (Angers) comes on as a substitute.
77' Jorge Sampaoli has decided to substitute Jordan James and he is replaced by Glen Kamara (Rennes).
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jota (Rennes) will replace Ludovic Blas.

76' The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick. What a chance for Himad Abdelli (Angers) as he produced a stunning snap shot from the edge of the box! The goalkeeper was a bit lucky as the ball goes inches over the crossbar.

72' Angers slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
71' Rennes quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
68' That's the end of the game for Yassine Belkhdim, who is replaced by Zinedine Ferhat (Angers).
67' Alexandre Dujeux prepares a substitution. Lilian Rao-Lisoa is replaced by Esteban Lepaul (Angers).
67' The ball is cleared after Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
65' Mahamadou Nagida (Rennes) shows his brilliant passing ability after picking out Albert Gronbaek with a fine lofted pass.
63' Yahia Fofana leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Ludovic Blas (Rennes).
61' A pass from Mahamadou Nagida (Rennes) is intercepted by Yahia Fofana and the move breaks down.
56' Leo Ostigard (Rennes) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
56' Dangerous play by Mahamadou Nagida (Rennes). Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle for a foul.
55' Jordan James (Rennes) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
52' The Rennes players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
49' Lilian Rao-Lisoa (Angers) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.

48' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Angers are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
46' Here's the change. Florent Hanin leaves the pitch and Jacques Ekomie (Angers) comes on as a substitute.
45+4' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Jordan James (Rennes) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem saw the whole situation.

45+1' A cross is slung in towards the penalty spot and Ibrahima Niane (Angers) creates space for himself but sends his header inches over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
40' Carlens Arcus (Angers) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
39' A yellow card for a tackle by Jordan James (Rennes). Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.

35' Himad Abdelli (Angers) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem with no other option than to blow for a foul.

33' 1 - 0 Goal – 1:0! Ludovic Blas sends a precise lofted pass into the box, Albert Gronbaek (Rennes) rises above the defenders to meet the ball near the penalty spot and heads it straight into the bottom right corner.

31' Jordan James (Rennes) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.
28' Steve Mandanda displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Ibrahima Niane (Angers) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
24' Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
23' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is out of play. Rennes will take a throw-in.
20' 54:46 – the ratio of ball possession.
15' Amine Gouiri is being substituted because of an injury. Jorge Sampaoli sends Albert Gronbaek (Rennes) on the pitch.
12' The game is interrupted now, Amine Gouiri (Rennes) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
11' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem has a clear sight and sees a foul from Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers).
11' Ibrahima Niane (Angers) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
9' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
9' Yahia Fofana (Angers) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
9' Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Yahia Fofana intercepts the ball.
7' The free kick into the penalty area from Lilian Rao-Lisoa (Angers) is cleared.
6' Jordan James (Rennes) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
4' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Rennes, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
3' Lilian Rao-Lisoa (Angers) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem no option but to blow his whistle.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Rennes will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem.
Show lineups Both teams starting lineups are available now, so you can have a look at them.
Show lineups
